# Silk Road AI Solutions

> Done-for-you AI customer acquisition and workflow automation for service businesses: logistics and 3PLs, CPA and accounting firms, health and wellness practices, and other growing service companies. Based in Park City, Utah. Founded by Dallas Wymes, a 35-year supply chain and operations executive.

Silk Road AI Solutions builds and runs AI systems that answer inbound leads in minutes, follow up automatically, book consultations, and remove the operational bottlenecks that keep owners working in the business instead of on it. Engagements start with a 30-day pilot with no further obligation. HIPAA-aware deployments with a BAA are available.

- [Freight Agency Case Study](https://silkroadaisolutions.com/case-study-freight-agency): how a freight agency got 8 hours a week back with AI
- [Partner Program](https://silkroadaisolutions.com/partners): referral partners earn 25% of net revenue for six months; contracted sales partners earn 35% in year one, 25% in year two, 15% after
